title: German insurance giant Munich Re agrees to acquire cyber insurance provider At-Bay for $575M; At-Bay has raised $276M and was last valued at $1.35B in 2021 (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: German insurance giant Munich Re agrees to acquire cyber insurance provider At-Bay for $575M; At-Bay has raised $276M and was last valued at $1.35B in 2021 — The German insurance giant is buying the cyber insurtech at less than half its 2021 valuation, as insurers increasingly seek …
